assertions.check: Each idea has a clearly stated problem affecting a specific, named customer segment
Each idea has a revenue model with pricing range and payment trigger
Market size estimates cite specific data sources (reports, databases, public filings)
Founder-fit scoring references specific founder skills/experience, not generic traits
At least one idea leverages AI as a core differentiator, not just a feature
Each idea identifies at least 2 existing alternatives and explains why they're insufficient
Time-to-revenue estimate includes specific assumptions (team size, stack, integrations needed)
Recommendation includes explicit reasoning for why rejected ideas were ranked lower

meta_assertion: Could a seed-stage investor read this and understand why this opportunity is worth pursuing?
test_prompt: Generate idea briefs for a SaaS startup in the developer tools space, targeting solo developers who struggle with deployment.
